verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents the v3 Mail Send API, sandbox mode, webhooks and templates. Nothing in it covers scheduling a send for a future time, or cancelling or pausing a scheduled send. Sandbox mode only validates a request without delivering it; it is not scheduling or cancellation and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule an email for future delivery through the API and cancel it before it goes out
